description:
Doom-related tools for Java. Home of DECOHack and lots of other utilities. Build WAD projects (and soon, other kinds) with ease!

DoomTools is a set of command-line utilities for building projects or for other things related to Doom Engine games.
Changes
- 2026-10-16 Made process modals cancellable.
- 2026-10-10 Updated RookScript to 1.20.1. Changes here.
- 2026-10-06 Fixes to potential file separators in XDG paths.
DoomMake
Changed for 0.38.0
- Added A way to output all of DoomMake's functions and scopes as JSON with the --function-help-json switch.
- Added [GUI-Studio] A Map Browser tab for quick-finding maps (Enh. #205).
- Changed [GUI-Studio] A slight change to pop-up menu layouts for single selected files.
- Changed [GUI-Studio] More efficient handling for file system changes and responses.
WadScript
Changed for 1.10.0
- Added A way to output all of WadScript's functions and scopes as JSON with the --function-help-json switch.
WTexScan
Changed for 1.4.1
- Fixed [GUI] Loading "Map Name" from workspace state would set bad information.
WadTex
Changed for 1.5.7
- Fixed [GUI-TextureEditor] Sometimes the first patch of a texture would not be "current", even if selected by default. (Issue #204)
